evidence.quote:
The 2025 World artificial intelligence (AI) Conference and High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance published Global AI Governance Action Plan on July 26. 
Full text of the action plan:

english_version.note: The issuing government published the English text as the full text of the plan, so it counts as one of the issuer's own texts. Whether the Chinese version is the drafting original and the English a translation cannot be told from the stored file. No web search was needed.

title.source_quote:
Global AI Governance Action Plan
 Updated: July 26, 2025 23:55
title.why: The title is quoted from the stored English text. original_title is null and no Chinese text is stored, so there is nothing to compare it with.

summary_claims.claim: calls for timely AI risk assessment, risk testing and evaluation systems, tiered and categorised management, a widely recognised safety governance framework
summary_claims.locator: item 10, Advancing the governance of AI safety
summary_claims.original_quote: We need to conduct timely risk assessment of AI and propose targeted prevention and response measures to establish a widely recognized safety governance framework. We need to explore categorized and tiered management approaches, build a risk testing and evaluation system for AI

summary_claims.claim: regular safety assessments of AI used in public services
summary_claims.locator: item 9, Spearheading deployment and application by the public sector
summary_claims.original_quote: At the same time, assessment of the safety of the aforementioned AI systems should be conducted regularly
summary_claims.literal_translation: (source is English; 'aforementioned AI systems' are AI deployed in public services such as healthcare, education and transportation)

summary_claims.claim: support for the UN Independent International Scientific Panel on AI and the Global Dialogue on AI Governance
summary_claims.locator: item 11, Jointly implementing the Global Digital Compact
summary_claims.original_quote: We need to support the establishment and early operation of two mechanisms under the U.N. framework—the Independent International Scientific Panel on AI and the Global Dialogue on AI Governance

key_terms.note: The plan says 'We need to explore' these approaches; the register's 'calls for' drops the hedge.
